unresolvedReferences.description: 四年九月 names no reign. It is not converted to Shunzhi 4 or Kangxi 4. Shunzhi 4 would precede the Shunzhi 7 and 9 events in the same note, and Kangxi 4 is after Bahunte's Shunzhi 18 succession.
善慶's father is written 馬官正. The previous row is 馬正官. The character order differs, so s0046 is not used as evidence that 馬正官 and 馬官正 are the same man.
十四九月 omits 年. It is read as the ninth month of Jiaqing 14 because 嘉慶七年 opens the same note, not as a separate reign.
崇慶 is Chongqing county in Sichuan. The packet English says Chongqing; it is not the city 重慶.
The column heading is 一等肅毅侯. Li Hongzhang's row says he was enfeoffed 一等肅清毅伯 and posthumously raised to 一等侯. The heading is not treated as a separate title he held.
四年，降二等 names no reign. It stands after 十三年 in a Daoguang note, so it is not converted to Daoguang 4, which would fall before Daoguang 8.

The cell narrates Jiaqing 15 (promoted to first-class viscount) before Jiaqing 14 (promoted to third-class earl). The chapter contradicts itself. Both promotions are recorded as written, and the written order is not treated as a chronological sequence.

The column heading is third-class Marquis Weiqin, but s0420 says Lebao was first-class Marquis Weiqin, then Duke Weiqin, and was posthumously advanced to first-class Marquis Weiqin. The heir in s0421 was enfeoffed only as third-class marquis. The heading is not treated as Lebao's rank.
The cell says he was enfeoffed for 迎順 and does not name 恭順侯. That title appears only as the column heading s0439, whose literal is Marquis Gongshun.

果勇 is Marquis Guoyong in this cell and in the s0399 literal, while the s0399 idiomatic said Fruitful Valor. The idiomatic heading is repaired to Resolute Valor; Guoyong is left as the packet's transliteration.
The idiomatic heading translates 同安侯 as Marquis of Shared Peace. 同安 is Tong'an, and the literal already says Marquis Tong'an. The idiomatic heading is repaired.
The cell says Tan Hong was enfeoffed for submitting and does not name 慕義侯. That title appears only as the column heading s0479, whose literal is Marquis Muyi.

The cell gives Lin Xingzhu's banner and says there was no succession. It does not narrate a grant of 建義侯, which appears only as the column heading s0499, and it states no year. No life year is inferred.
